description: Company directors in France (dirigeants: CEO, président, gérant, DG, administrateurs) with their probable business email, from a SIREN or a company name. Official RNE registry data, company web domain, mail provider, probable email per officer (pattern-based, not SMTP-verified) and alternatives. 0.02 USDC per call, charged only if found. Nothing stored (GDPR).
